title: The prime field is not a maximal clique in GP(5^8,3): a counterexample to Yip's maximal subfield clique conjecture
scope: For q=5^8, d=3 (largest admissible r=1), in every field of order 5^8 the prime field F_5 is a clique of GP(5^8,3) but not maximal (x=2θ+4θ^2+θ^3, f(θ)=0, f=X^8+X^7+2X^6+2). Refutes the unrestricted conjecture; ALCO Theorem 1.2 (q>(n-1)^2) untouched.
source_targets: Yip, J. Algebraic Combin. 56(2) (2022) 323-333, arXiv:2101.09652 Conjecture 1.4
substantive_reason: Refutes in exact universal scope a published conjecture that its author later announced as confirmed and a 2025 paper restates as proved without the size hypothesis; also shows the explicit remark that q>(n-1)^2 can be dropped is false. Not implied by any known theorem; lies outside the source computer checks (n<=5; n=6, q<=17).
